questions.question: At which ground did Michelle Schoeman record their career-best bowling figures (2-19, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Limpopo Lillies on 2022/02/05.

questions.question: Iinyathi set a database record (19/20 season, T20) with a value of 129. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Biggest Win by Runs', held by Iinyathi.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Matches Played' (combined T20 + List A)?

questions.question: At which ground did Rhinos record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 46, against Limpopo Lillies on 2019/02/03.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Sixes' in the 13/14 season (combined T20 + List A)?

questions.question: Which of these players was born in South Africa and went on to represent another country internationally, but never represented a South African provincial team?
questions.explanation: Scholfield was born in Amanzimtoti and made her debut for England in September 2024.
